doc.summary: fetch.sh - clone the gb-recompiled tool into progs/pokemon/upstream.
doc.description: The upstream project ships the recompiler + runtime, but no ROMs and no pre-generated game code (see its README). You generate a project from a ROM you legally own, then point the MiniOS build at it. See README.md.  Usage: ./fetch.sh   (safe to re-run; never touches an existing checkout)
